title: Fundamentals of Zen Practice
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching emphasizes the importance of cultivating stability and insight through meditation practice, recognizing that these two qualities are interconnected and inseparable. By focusing on the breath and letting go of attachment to thoughts or outcomes, we can touch into our true nature and experience reality more clearly. This practice allows us to see things with fresh eyes, free from judgment and reactivity, and respond to challenges in a more open and liberated way.
